name: Job hunt
description: Google's job listings through Monid (about $0.0025 a search), then NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL shortlists up to five that fit what it knows about your work, and notes what you looked for. Needs MONID_API_KEY and NEBIUS_API_KEY.
example: Backend engineer, Node.js or Go, Bengaluru

assistants.name: Google Jobs (Monid)
assistants.description: Open jobs from Google's job listings, through Monid: about $0.0025 a search.

assistants.name: Shortlister
assistants.description: Picks the openings that fit what it knows about my work.
